title: [Chapitre] IX et IX bis. [Ateliers] : notes manuscrites (05-15/07/1986).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting: a set E with a symmetric 'orthogonality' or 'disjointness' relation x|o|y. Grothendieck calls such a structure a 'dispositif'; the reading is uncertain. To it he attaches Σ_E, the complete lattice of subsets closed for the Galois connection A ↦ A^⊥ (so A = A^⊥⊥). It carries a complement C(A) = A^⊥ and the canonical map σ_E : E → Σ_E, x ↦ {x}^⊥⊥. The canonical preorder on E is x ≤ y iff σ(x) ⊆ σ(y), equivalently x^⊥ ⊇ y^⊥. The previous page proved a universal property: Σ_E is generated by σ_E(E) under sups.

The Corollary concerns a subset E' ⊂ E with the induced relation. It asks when Σ_{E'} ≅ Σ_E canonically. The equivalent conditions are:
(i) σ_E(E') is sup-dense in Σ_E.
(ii) S ↦ S∩E' maps Σ_E bijectively onto Σ_{E'} (map φ).
(iii) S' ↦ sup σ_E(S') is a bijection Σ_{E'} → Σ_E (map ψ).
(iv) E' is dense in E for the canonical preorder.
(v) A separation condition: for x, y ∈ E, if x'|o|y' for all x', y' ∈ E' with x' ≤ x and y' ≤ y, then x|o|y.

This page states that φ and ψ are then mutually inverse isomorphisms of ordered/orthogonality structures, and proves part of the equivalences.
- (i)⇔(iv) follows by transitivity of order-density, using associativity of sups. Grothendieck warns that 'dense' here is order-theoretic, not topological.
- (iv)⇒(v) holds because in Σ, if x = sup x_i, y = sup y_j and x_i ⊥ y_j for all i, j, then x ⊥ y.
- (v)⇒(iv): take ξ ∈ σ(E) and let S' be the elements of σ(E') below ξ. To show ξ = sup S', use the lemma written on the next sheet: if every element of S' is ≤ ξ, then ξ = sup S' iff for every η in a dense set, S' ⊥ η implies ξ ⊥ η. Given S' ⊥ η, let J' be the elements of σ(E') below η. Then ξ' ⊥ η' for all ξ' ∈ S' and η' ∈ J', and hypothesis (v) gives ξ ⊥ η.

The purpose is to show that the 'completion' Σ_E of an orthogonality structure depends only on a dense part. This is the analogue, for polarities and orthogonality spaces, of the fact that the Dedekind–MacNeille completion is unchanged by passing to a join-dense subset.
errors: No mathematical error is visible. Some steps are compressed but sound.
The proof of (v)⇒(iv) relies on the lemma written on the following sheet (archive p.85, Grothendieck's no. 82), whose proof uses the density of σ(E) in Σ and the complement C.
In (v), x' and y' must range over E' (or σ(E')). This is implicit in the image.
If no element of E' lies below x, condition (v) forces x to be orthogonal to everything, i.e. x is a 'zero' element. This is consistent with the theory but goes unremarked.

ideas.what: Lattice Σ_E of biorthogonally closed subsets of a set with a symmetric orthogonality relation, with canonical map σ_E and canonical preorder
ideas.modern_name: Orthogonality spaces / polarities; complete ortholattice of ⊥-closed sets (Galois connection of a binary relation)
ideas.usually_credited_to: G. Birkhoff (polarities, 1940); Dacey (1968); Foulis–Randall (1970s orthogonality spaces)

ideas.what: Invariance of the completion under passage to an order-dense subset, with equivalent conditions including a 'separation' condition (v)
ideas.modern_name: Join-dense subsets determine the Dedekind–MacNeille-type completion

ideas.what: Criterion: sup S' = ξ iff for all η in a dense set, S'⊥η ⇒ ξ⊥η
ideas.modern_name: Characterization of joins in ortholattices via orthocomplements and density

missed.claim: Historical note: in July 1986, in the non-mathematical 'Ateliers' notes, Grothendieck independently develops a small theory of orthogonality relations and their completions. The material is standard, but its presence in this corpus is undocumented.
missed.quote: Attention, "dense" ici au sens de la relation d'ordre, qui [...] guère [...] sens de la topologie associée à l'ordre
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Only for biographical and historical study of Grothendieck's 1986 writings. There is no new mathematics.

deep.surprise_reason: This is a correct but routine lattice-theoretic result: a join-dense subset of an orthogonality space yields the same ⊥-closure completion. It is well known from polarity and ortholattice theory.
transcription_corrections: Top page number reads 87 (Grothendieck's numbering); 84 at bottom left is the archive page number.
'on a ξ|0|η, ou ξ|0|η' should read roughly: 'pour tout η ∈ σ(E), on a S'|o|η ⟹ ξ|o|η' (cela signifie, par le lemme, que ...).
In (v), x', y' are taken in E' ('∀x', y' ∈ E' avec x' ≤ x, y' ≤ y').
'(i) étant,' inserted above should be '(évident)' — i.e. '(i)⟺(iv) (évident), compte tenu que (iv) signifie aussi que σ(E') est dense dans σ(E)'.
'mais un [?] [?] transitivité' likely 'mais on a [bien] transitivité de la notion de densité, grâce à l'associativité des sup'.
Last line: 'Par hyp., cela implique ξ|o|η, OK' is correct; the preceding words are 'ξ'|o|η' pour ξ' ∈ S', η' ∈ J''.
